description.value: Bluetail Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Kelowna's Commerce Avenue area, emphasizing fresh, high-quality ingredients and an elevated dining experience. The business recently consolidated two locations into this single Commerce Avenue spot, extending its hours in the process. A solid sit-down option for touring cyclists looking for a proper Japanese meal in the Kelowna area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the business is real, open, and operating at the Commerce Avenue location. The address (102-1675 Commerce Avenue, Kelowna, BC, V1X 8A9) and phone (778-484-5900) match OSM exactly. The website mentions the Spall location has closed and merged into Commerce — no impact on this record, but worth flagging in case a separate Spall OSM record exists. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, takeout, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Website notice states the Spall Road location closed as of July 16th and merged into Commerce. If a separate OSM record exists for the Spall location, it should be reviewed for closure.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, confirmed-open Japanese restaurant at the listed Commerce Avenue address. A valid stop for touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal in Kelowna.
